patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: My eye's been red and goopy since yesterday, kind of crusty when I wake up. It's not really painful and my vision's totally fine — my kid had the exact same thing last week.
clinical.presentationShort: 28yo F — unilateral red eye with discharge, NO pain, normal vision, no photophobia; sick contact — conjunctivitis.
clinical.presentationLong: 28-year-old female with a red, discharging eye, no pain, normal visual acuity, and no photophobia, with a sick contact at home — conjunctivitis.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → hygiene, warm compresses, ± topical antibiotic; return for eye pain or vision change.
diagnosis.why: Red eye + discharge but NO pain, NO vision loss, NO photophobia → benign conjunctivitis. Hygiene and reassurance. (Pain or vision change = worry.)

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, lightly pointing at one red, watery eye
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 28-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, lightly gesturing at one red, watery eye. Expression: mildly annoyed but otherwise well. Clearly visible: one reddened, watery eye; she otherwise looks healthy. No text, no logos.
